cards.back:
What the sky and air are like outside.
Bahasa Indonesia: cuaca
Example: The weather is hot and sunny today.
cards.say: weather. What the sky and air are like outside. The weather is hot and sunny today.

cards.back:
Bright with lots of sun.
Bahasa Indonesia: cerah
Example: It was a sunny day, so we went swimming.
cards.say: sunny. Bright with lots of sun. It was a sunny day, so we went swimming.

cards.back:
Full of clouds in the sky.
Bahasa Indonesia: berawan
Example: The sky is cloudy this morning.
cards.say: cloudy. Full of clouds in the sky. The sky is cloudy this morning.

cards.back:
With a lot of rain.
Bahasa Indonesia: hujan
Example: We stayed home on the rainy afternoon.
cards.say: rainy. With a lot of rain. We stayed home on the rainy afternoon.

cards.back:
With a lot of wind.
Bahasa Indonesia: berangin
Example: It was too windy to fly our kite.
cards.say: windy. With a lot of wind. It was too windy to fly our kite.

cards.back:
Full of thick cloud near the ground, hard to see through.
Bahasa Indonesia: berkabut
Example: The road was foggy, so the bus drove slowly.
cards.say: foggy. Full of thick cloud near the ground, hard to see through. The road was foggy, so the bus drove slowly.

cards.back:
With strong wind, rain and thunder.
Bahasa Indonesia: badai, cuaca badai
Example: The sea was stormy and the boats stayed in.
cards.say: stormy. With strong wind, rain and thunder. The sea was stormy and the boats stayed in.

cards.back:
With lots of snow falling.
Bahasa Indonesia: bersalju
Example: It was a snowy day, so we made a snowman.
cards.say: snowy. With lots of snow falling. It was a snowy day, so we made a snowman.

cards.back:
The loud noise in the sky during a storm.
Bahasa Indonesia: guntur
Example: The thunder was so loud that the dog hid.
cards.say: thunder. The loud noise in the sky during a storm. The thunder was so loud that the dog hid.

cards.back:
A bright flash of light in the sky during a storm.
Bahasa Indonesia: kilat
Example: We saw lightning over the sea.
cards.say: lightning. A bright flash of light in the sky during a storm. We saw lightning over the sea.

cards.back:
A curved band of colours in the sky.
Bahasa Indonesia: pelangi
Example: A rainbow appeared after the rain.
cards.say: rainbow. A curved band of colours in the sky. A rainbow appeared after the rain.

cards.back:
A small pool of water on the ground.
Bahasa Indonesia: genangan
Example: He jumped in the puddle with his boots.
cards.say: puddle. A small pool of water on the ground. He jumped in the puddle with his boots.

cards.back:
How hot or cold something is.
Bahasa Indonesia: suhu
Example: The temperature today is thirty degrees Celsius.
cards.say: temperature. How hot or cold something is. The temperature today is thirty degrees Celsius.

cards.back:
Very cold, cold enough to turn water into ice.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat dingin
Example: It is freezing, so wear your coat.
cards.say: freezing. Very cold, cold enough to turn water into ice. It is freezing, so wear your coat.

cards.back:
Very hot.
Bahasa Indonesia: sangat panas
Example: It is boiling in the classroom today.
cards.say: boiling. Very hot. It is boiling in the classroom today.

cards.back:
A light, gentle wind.
Bahasa Indonesia: angin sepoi-sepoi
Example: A cool breeze came in through the window.
cards.say: breeze. A light, gentle wind. A cool breeze came in through the window.

cards.back:
A lot of water covering land that is usually dry.
Bahasa Indonesia: banjir
Example: The flood covered the road after heavy rain.
cards.say: flood. A lot of water covering land that is usually dry. The flood covered the road after heavy rain.

cards.back:
A report that says what the weather will be like.
Bahasa Indonesia: prakiraan cuaca
Example: The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
cards.say: forecast. A report that says what the weather will be like. The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.

cards.back:
A round cover that keeps the rain off you.
Bahasa Indonesia: payung
Example: Take an umbrella because it may rain.
cards.say: umbrella. A round cover that keeps the rain off you. Take an umbrella because it may rain.

cards.back:
One of the parts of the year with its own kind of weather, such as summer.
Bahasa Indonesia: musim
Example: Summer is my favourite season of the year.
cards.say: season. One of the parts of the year with its own kind of weather, such as summer. Summer is my favourite season of the year.

cards.back:
The time of year when it rains a lot.
Bahasa Indonesia: musim hujan
Example: Rivers are full in the wet season.
cards.say: wet season. The time of year when it rains a lot. Rivers are full in the wet season.

cards.back:
The time of year when it hardly rains.
Bahasa Indonesia: musim kemarau
Example: Farmers wait for rain in the dry season.
cards.say: dry season. The time of year when it hardly rains. Farmers wait for rain in the dry season.
